source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy every zero-only translation of the embedded nonzero shape."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    if not counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The marker color is the rare nonzero color; the abundant nonzero color
    # is the background blocker.
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    seed = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color}
    r0 = min(r for r, c in seed)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in seed)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in seed}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 0
                   for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
